name: markdown-editor-frontend
description: Build step for the vendored client-side markdown rendering bundle (marked + KaTeX + highlight.js). Not used at runtime by the Python app — output is committed to ../static/vendor/.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=../static/vendor/editor-bundle.js && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css ../static/vendor/katex/katex.min.css && cp -r node_modules/katex/dist/fonts ../static/vendor/katex/
